name: BiasFreeBench
description: BiasFreeBench is an empirical benchmark designed to evaluate and compare bias mitigation techniques for large language models. It reorganizes existing datasets into a unified query-response format covering multi-choice and open-ended multi-turn QA, and introduces a response-level Bias-Free Score to measure fairness, safety, and anti-stereotypical qualities in model outputs.
reputation: A recent benchmark proposal for bias evaluation in LLMs that is still emerging and not yet broadly established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Covers 8 bias mitigation methods and 2 test scenarios; aims to unify evaluation for bias mitigation research.
